proof_claim: Every unlocked transition element has declared dependencies and no Level 5 element depends on an uncovered or lower-confidence element without an explicit boundary.
purpose: Proves that unlocked elements compose safely and that AI Blocks can be formally verified against declared dependency constraints.

AE.name: Admissible Existence
composition_rules: AE requires all dependencies to be verified before composition
AE gate is the final gate — passes only when IW contained AND RE within bound
AE cannot be composed without BC, CHF, DC each independently verified

BC.name: Boundary Coherence
composition_rules: BC load-capacity check must precede any boundary-crossing composition
BC failure propagates to all compositions containing BC

CHF.name: Consequence Horizon
composition_rules: CHF absorption check must precede any high-consequence-mass composition
Purpose-convergence test must pass before CHF ALLOW

DC.name: Distributed Coherence
composition_rules: DC global condition must be checked even when all local nodes pass
Split-brain condition routes to QUARANTINE not DENY
DC depends on BC — BC failure propagates to DC

DaCo.name: Data Continuity
composition_rules: Commit-time state must be verified at the boundary, not pre-commit
Replay reconstructs receipt state; replay cannot reverse consequence
DaCo gap honesty: missing receipt is explicit gap, not inferred absence

Triad.name: GCAT/BCAT/Triad
composition_rules: GCAT invariant I(x) = a - K*g^alpha*c^beta*t^gamma <= 0 must hold
Triad failure is FAIL_CLOSED not DENY
Triad is the legitimacy gate — precedes all other gates in composed checks

IW.name: Inference Window
composition_rules: IW is a primitive — no upstream dependencies
IW width must exceed IW_minimum or transition fails closed
IW containment check: IW_tau(S,u) subset A_total
Wider IW requires stronger primitive load

RE.name: Reverse Entropy
composition_rules: RE is a primitive — no upstream dependencies
RE(S -> Phi(S,u)) <= RE_max or transition fails closed
RE breach propagates immediately — no partial RE compliance

RESET_BOUNDARY.name: Governed Boundary Reset
composition_rules: RESET_BOUNDARY requires evidence of recoverable non-convergence
Convergence score must be below minimum threshold
Recoverability must be ABOVE floor — reset is not collapse
IW must be contained — reset operates within admissible space
Multi-party authority (A4) required for ecosystem-level resets

EVOLVE_BOUNDARY.name: Governed Boundary Evolution
composition_rules: EVOLVE_BOUNDARY requires coherence failure evidence
Purpose-convergence test must fail
Evolution must itself be bounded and recoverable
EVOLVE_BOUNDARY cannot produce unbounded drift
Multi-party authority (A4) required for governed evolution
Receipt required proving evolution scope and recoverability

AI_BLOCK.name: AI Block
theorem_coverage: Stage 6 Unified Gate — AI Block Admissibility
Stage 6 Unified Gate — AI Block Scope Violation
composition_rules: AI Block must be composed only from validated transition elements
All elements in the block must be at Level 5 or explicitly bounded
Block scope must be explicitly declared before composition
Attempted scope must not exceed declared block scope
AI_BLOCK cannot bypass P_NO_SANDBOX_ESCAPE primitive
AI_BLOCK cannot bypass P_NO_UNAUTHORIZED_SELF_PRESERVATION primitive
Continuity pressure does not create authority
Scope violation routes to FAIL_CLOSED — no partial scope compliance
AI_BLOCK.authority_constraint: A7 — artificial authority; scope bounded by block definition

FINCO_CHAIN.name: FinCo Receipt Chain
theorem_coverage: Stage 6 Unified Gate — FinCo Chain Compliance
Stage 6 Unified Gate — FinCo Chain Failure
composition_rules: FINCO_CHAIN requires consent receipt before access receipt
Access receipt must reference consent receipt hash
Use receipt must reference access receipt hash
Compensation rule must be defined when value is extracted
Revocation rule must be defined
evidence_only must be true
creates_entitlement must be false
Broken chain routes to FAIL_CLOSED — no partial chain compliance
recoverability_delta must exceed minimum threshold
FINCO_CHAIN cannot bypass receipt requirements — no receipt means no admissibility
FINCO_CHAIN.receipt_constraint: full_chain_required: consent, access, use, compensation, revocation, governance

REPRESENTATION_NON_CONSEQUENCE.name: Representation Non-Consequence
composition_rules: Representation is a primitive — no upstream dependencies
Representation alone has no consequence-bearing status
Representation becomes consequence-bearing only when bound to role + transition + continuation path
Same data can produce ALLOW, ALLOW_WITH_SIGNOFF, or FAIL_CLOSED depending on role
Representation Non-Consequence is a gate precondition — must be checked before role binding

dependency_graph_constraints.note: Primitives have no upstream dependencies. All other elements depend on at least one primitive.
dependency_graph_constraints.acyclicity_rule: No element may depend on itself directly or transitively without an explicit cycle boundary declaration.
dependency_graph_constraints.level5_completeness_rule: Every Level 5 element must declare at least one dependency or be declared a primitive.
dependency_graph_constraints.uncovered_dependency_rule: No Level 5 element may depend on an element with status != verified without an explicit boundary declaration.
dependency_graph_constraints.ai_block_special_rule: AI_BLOCK dependency on AE means AI Block admissibility requires the full AE unified gate to pass. AI Blocks cannot shortcut the gate.
dependency_graph_constraints.finco_chain_special_rule: FINCO_CHAIN dependency on DaCo means receipt chain integrity requires data continuity. No receipt = no admissibility.

composition_safety_invariants.name: Authority Cannot Be Bypassed Through Composition
composition_safety_invariants.statement: No composition of elements may produce a result with higher authority than the minimum authority class of its constituent elements.

composition_safety_invariants.name: Receipt Requirement Propagates
composition_safety_invariants.statement: If any element in a composition requires a receipt, the composition requires a receipt.

composition_safety_invariants.name: Failure Propagates
composition_safety_invariants.statement: FAIL_CLOSED on any element in a composition produces FAIL_CLOSED on the composition. No partial compliance.

composition_safety_invariants.name: Primitives Cannot Be Overridden
composition_safety_invariants.statement: IW, RE, and REPRESENTATION_NON_CONSEQUENCE are primitives. No composition may override or bypass their checks.

composition_safety_invariants.name: AI Block Scope Is The Scope
composition_safety_invariants.statement: An AI Block's declared scope is its maximum capability. Composition cannot expand scope beyond the block definition.

composition_safety_invariants.name: Continuity Pressure Does Not Create Authority
composition_safety_invariants.statement: No element composition may produce an authority class that arises from continuity pressure rather than explicit authority grant.
